title: Building plan index
description: The distinct buildings one world stands on. Each plan is one Exterior shell generated on a canonical lot at the origin with face 0 along +X, standing in the shared store under the hash of its family, size, floor count, generator version and seed. A parcel names a plan and the frame it stands in; the world carries no geometry of its own.

exterior.description: The Exterior package version every shell here was generated by.

seed.description: The plan seed, which belongs to the plans and never to a city.

family.description: The approved Exterior family, or null for the generator's ordinary output.

baysAcross.description: Whole 8 m bays along the entrance face.

glb.description: The shell, relative to the shared store root.

blueprint.description: That shell's blueprint, relative to the shared store root.
